{{Quote|And eventually, as he dealt with some of the Chiss's enemies, he pushed things just a little too far. He was brought up on charges, stripped of all rank, and sent into exile on an uninhabited world at the edge of Imperial space.|Admiral Voss Parck|<ref name="VTF" />}}
By [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force|Expansionary Defense Force]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]]<ref name="OBF" /> [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] '''pre-emptively raided''' a ground installation in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] that was manufacturing weapons in a lead-up to an attack against the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]]. According to Ascendancy [[Defensive-only doctrine|law]], such a pre-emptive strike was illegal, and Thrawn's actions were judged to be in violation of all the Chiss believed regarding not attacking without direct, violent instigation by the enemy.<ref name="ME">{{JournalCite|7|Mist Encounter}}</ref> Unbeknownst to most was that Thrawn had actually engineered the conflict so that [[Gender/Legends|he]] was [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] and could&mdash;with no affiliation to the Expansionary Defense<ref name="RSBF" /> Force&mdash;<ref name="OBF" /> join the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="RSBF" />

The Ascendancy indeed exiled the officer,<ref name="RSBF" /> and sent him to an uninhabited [[Unidentified planet (Thrawn's exile)/Legends|planet]], where Imperial [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Voss Parck/Legends|Voss Parck]] captured Thrawn and brought him before [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], who accepted the Chiss into the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Fleet]].<ref name="ME" />

==Behind the scenes==
The conflict was first mentioned in the biographical capsule written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer]] that accompanied [[Timothy Zahn]]'s short story ''[[Mist Encounter]]'' in ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal 7]]''.<ref name="ME" /> Its role as an engineered downfall was explained in ''[[Vision of the Future]]'', the final installment in Zahn's ''[[Star Wars: The Hand of Thrawn Duology]]''.<ref name="VTF" />
